test_results.observation: Runtime configuration selected exactly one complete deterministic-local or OpenAI-compatible provider pair. Unsupported, incomplete, unsafe and unapproved embedding-space configuration failed explicitly without fallback.

OpenAI-compatible embedding returned ordered 1536-dimensional vectors and the authenticated HTTP ingestion adapter supplied the runtime Embedding Configuration to the shared IngestDocument application seam. PostgreSQL persisted the compatible configuration identity.
Embedding vector count/dimension and provider/model identity mismatches failed before ingestion commit or question retrieval/generation. No mismatch path used another provider.

The compatible generation adapter produced the locked Structured Generation Result. The complete PostgreSQL/HTTP path returned validated citations and persisted namespaced embedding and generation metadata including provider, model, prompt version, request IDs, finish reason, token usage and cost provenance.

Structured refusal and invalid-generation semantics remained application-owned. Malformed output, compatible-endpoint HTTP failure and timeout produced explicit sanitized errors with one request and no fallback or repair retry.

Provider credentials remained runtime-only and Pydantic SecretStr redacted them. Controlled HTTP error/timeout results contained no canary secret or provider body; the workspace canary scan returned CANARY_REDACTION=PASS.

Deterministic compatible-endpoint contract tests and PostgreSQL application integration passed without external credentials or semantic-quality claims. The final repository suite reported 88 tests passing, Ruff passing and Docker Compose configuration valid.
Provider-mode selection, fail-fast configuration validation and no-fallback behavior remain verified after remediation. Prompt content and version are now one code-owned immutable pair.

OpenAI-compatible embedding and runtime Embedding Configuration wiring remain valid. HTTP ingestion now executes its synchronous application/provider path in a worker thread rather than blocking the async route.
Embedding dimension/count and configuration mismatches still fail before persistence, retrieval or generation. Query embedding now runs in a worker thread without weakening those checks.
Structured compatible generation, cited HTTP responses and namespaced trace metadata remain valid. The trace prompt version is now coupled to the exact code-owned prompt text.
Structured refusal, invalid output, HTTP error and timeout behavior remain sanitized, single-attempt and fallback-free after remediation.

Runtime-only credential redaction remains verified. Internally owned synchronous and asynchronous HTTP clients now have explicit CLI/application-lifespan cleanup, while injected test clients remain caller-owned.

Compatible adapter contracts and PostgreSQL application integration remain green after review remediation. Final verification reported 89 tests passing, Ruff passing and Docker Compose configuration valid.
